subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `check-governing`, docgate shall verify the vision and principles documents contain no relative markdown link and no baseline requirement-ID citation (the SCAF/PLAN/IMPL/GATE/FLEET/IDEN/GOV/KNOW/OBS/BENCH/VNEXT families); when additionally given a merge base, it shall fail any diff touching either document whose commits lack the `Governing-Change: operator` trailer, and shall fail line modifications or deletions in either document even with the trailer (append-only).
rationale: the trust root's machine backing was half-built: only principles were line-checked, and link-direction purity was prompt-side only (#54 A2/A5)
fit_criterion: trailered line-edit of the vision red; trailered append to the vision green; a vision fixture containing a relative link or a `VNEXT-1` citation red naming the line; principles behavior unchanged (trailered line-edit still red); the real corpus green
